app_bugs.title: The app closes (crashes) on the Live TV channel list
app_bugs.screen: Live TV list (Browse, live channels), any theme and layout
app_bugs.what: While the channel list is being drawn or scrolled, the app suddenly closes. It happens at random: when opening Live TV, changing category, filtering, or scrolling quickly. Seen with the normal test provider and with the huge one.
app_bugs.expected: The list keeps working; the 'Now:' programme line under each channel simply appears when it is ready.
steps: Open the app and choose Live TV.
Move between categories (or type in the search box, or scroll quickly down the list).
The app closes without a message, at random (several times per weekly run).
app_bugs.cause: BrowseActivity.bindNowPlaying(): the coroutine that loads a channel's 'Now' programme calls itemAdapter.notifyItemChanged() while the RecyclerView is still laying out (it can run straight away inside onBindViewHolder). Android does not allow that and throws IllegalStateException.
error_contains: Cannot call this method while RecyclerView is computing a layout or scrolling

app_bugs.title: Search closes the app when the server sends a broken list
app_bugs.what: With a provider whose lists come back broken (an error page or cut-off data), opening Search makes the app close instead of showing a message. The Live TV, Movies and Series screens handle the same server correctly ('Couldn't load categories').
app_bugs.expected: Search shows 'Couldn't load the library…' and stays open.
steps: Log in to a provider whose channel/movie/series lists fail (the test uses the fake 'broken' account).
app_bugs.cause: SearchActivity.loadLibrary(): the three lists load with async { } inside lifecycleScope.launch. When one fails, the failure cancels the parent coroutine and is re-thrown outside the try/catch, so the catch block never shows the message (structured concurrency). Wrapping the async calls in coroutineScope { } / supervisorScope { } inside the try would keep the error inside it.

app_bugs.title: Quick drawer: TV guide does nothing (until a channel has been played)
app_bugs.screen: Home › Menu key › quick drawer › TV guide
app_bugs.what: Pressing OK on 'TV guide' in the new quick drawer closes the drawer and nothing opens. Opening the Live TV list first doesn't help; it only works after a channel has been played (or the guide opened from the Live TV list) in that session.
app_bugs.expected: The TV guide opens with all channels.
steps: Press the Menu key on the remote: the quick drawer opens.
Move to 'TV guide' and press OK: the drawer closes and the guide does not open.
Same after opening the Live TV list and coming back to Home.
app_bugs.cause: HomeActivity's quick drawer starts GuideActivity with a plain Intent. GuideActivity.onCreate() takes its channels from Session.zapList and calls finish() when that list is empty; the list is only filled when a channel is played, when the guide is opened from the Live TV list, or from Search.
error_must_contain: TV guide in the quick drawer

app_bugs.title: Series page: Play and Favorites buttons hidden behind the seasons at large sizes
app_bugs.screen: Series details page, Settings › Look › Interface size Large with Text size Large or Extra large
app_bugs.what: The row with Play / Resume and '☆ Add to favorites' is cut off just above the Season 1 / 2 / 3 buttons: only its top edge is visible.
app_bugs.expected: All buttons fully visible (the page scrolls or the rows move down).
steps: Settings › Look: Interface size = Large, Text size = Large or Extra large.
Open Series and choose a series with several seasons.
The Play and Favorites buttons are cut off under the season buttons.
app_bugs.cause: activity_details_series.xml: the top block (@id/info: title, ratings, plot, cast, buttons) has layout_height=0dp with layout_weight=1, so it only gets the space left above the seasons and episodes. With larger text it no longer fits and its last row, the buttons, is clipped.

app_bugs.title: Nothing is highlighted on Home after switching to the Dock layout
app_bugs.screen: Home (Dock layout), right after changing the layout in Settings
app_bugs.what: Coming back from Settings after choosing Dock, Home is rebuilt with no visible highlight: the remote's focus sits on the gear button of the old layout, which Dock keeps hidden. One arrow press brings the highlight back (on Live TV).
app_bugs.expected: A Dock tile (for example Live TV) is highlighted.
steps: Use the Big tiles Home layout.
Highlight the gear (Settings) button and press OK.
Settings › Home layout: choose Dock, then press Back.
Home appears as Dock with nothing highlighted.
app_bugs.cause: HomeActivity.onResume() calls recreate() when the look changed; Android restores the focus to the view that had it before (@id/settings_button). In activity_home_dock.xml that view exists only inside a hidden (visibility gone) container, so the highlight lands on an invisible view. Moving focus to tile_live after a rebuild (or not restoring focus) would avoid it.
error_must_contain: an item on Home is highlighted
